propositions: A new surface-parity overlay must be added to the code-review gate to catch when a write-op parameter, guard, or required-field changes on one adapter (CLI, lib, or MCP) without synchronized updates to sibling adapters.

The overlay must be glob-triggered on write-surface adapter files (_commands/*, _lib_writes.py, _mcp_writes.py) and remain inert on unrelated diffs, with routing entries in criteria_routing.json and dispatch in round_a/round_b batches of code-review.yaml.

The overlay operates in advisory mode (blocking_enabled=false, block_threshold=0.95) and carries false-positive guards for deliberate justified divergences, adapter-bound params, and internal-only refactors to avoid spurious findings.

The base-reviewer overlay catalog in code-review-base.md must enumerate surface-parity alongside other overlays, with test_base_prompt_enumerates_exactly_the_overlay_ids enforcing lockstep with OVERLAY_IDS.
